# Troy Meekhof

> Troy Meekhof is a filmmaker and digital marketer in Caledonia (Grand Rapids area), Michigan, USA. He is the wedding videographer behind Mid-July Media, co-founder and creative director of Grand Rapids Marketing Co., and the Cybertruck content creator known as "The Cybertruck Guy" (@cybrtrkguy on X and YouTube).

## Canonical facts
- Name: Troy Meekhof (pronounced MEEK-hoff). Alias: The Cybertruck Guy.
- Location: Caledonia, Michigan (serves Grand Rapids / West Michigan; travels statewide and to the Chicago suburbs for weddings).
- Education: Grand Valley State University, B.A. Film/Video + Communication Studies, 2020.
- Credentials: FAA Part 107 remote pilot.
- Businesses: Mid-July Media (wedding films, since July 2019, https://midjulymedia.com; Silver $2,750, Gold $3,600, Documentary $4,900); Grand Rapids Marketing Co. (marketing agency, co-founded with Sam Kiste, https://grandrapidsmarketingco.com; local SEO retainers $1,197–$3,497/mo).
- Employment history: Senior Media Production Specialist, LMCU (2024-2025); Digital Marketing Manager, Treadstone Funding (2022-2024, grew organic traffic 10x); Marketing & Media Specialist, Northern Mortgage (2017-2022).
- Audience: ~26.8K followers on X; ~50M impressions in the 12 months to Sept 2026.
- Press: quoted in Newsweek (Nov 2024) and Torque News (Jun 2025) on Cybertruck ownership; Evotrex brand ambassador; filmed the "Split the Mitten" documentary (covered by MLive); speaker at Tesla Owners Club of Michigan Summer Meetup 2026.

## What Troy does NOT do
- He does not rent out his Cybertruck (older articles about rentals are historical; the program is closed).
- He is not a Tesla employee and does not speak for Tesla.
- He does not use associate videographers at Mid-July Media; he films every wedding himself.
